West Indies Level T20 Series With Record Chase Against India

West Indies defeated India by 6 wickets in the second T20 International to level the series 1-1, successfully chasing a target of 249 runs. Shai Hope scored an unbeaten 102 off 45 balls, and Sherfane Rutherford contributed 84 off 37 balls, marking the West Indies' highest successful chase in the shortest format. India had posted 249/5, with Sanju Samson scoring 82, and contributions from Kishan, Iyer, and Varma. The match saw numerous records broken.
